capabilities: Edit .drawio and .dio files in an embedded draw.io editor
Create new diagrams from ribbon, command palette, or file menu
Insert diagram links into notes with a searchable picker
Sync editor theme with Obsidian's light/dark theme
Point to a self-hosted draw.io server for offline use
extras: Default editor loads from embed.diagrams.net and needs internet; offline use requires configuring a self-hosted draw.io instance. Community plugins listing marked as coming soon, with manual installation instructions provided.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open or edit draw.io diagram files stored in the vault.
summary: Draw.io diagram editor that opens and edits .drawio and .dio files in an embedded Obsidian tab with auto-save and theme sync.
